mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to create an AccessAttempt where a ComplianceOfficer caller reaches GetRecord or PostNote with a Permitted outcome, directly violating FR-007 and LeastPrivilege. The injection forces exactly such an instance.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceContentBlindViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.aaCaller.role = ComplianceOfficer and a.aaEndpoint = GetRecord and a.aaOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact decouples the outcome from the care-team and ownership conditions. The injection forces a Clinician with no CareTeamMembership to obtain Permitted access to GetRecord, breaking FR-004 and OwnershipBasedAccess.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.aaCaller.role = Clinician and a.aaEndpoint = GetRecord and a.aaOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctmClinician = a.aaCaller and m.ctmRecord = a.aaTargetRecord) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two distinct AccessAttempts to share the same AuditEntry atom, breaking the one-to-one audit mapping required by FR-013 and FR-015. The injection forces exactly two AccessAttempts to map to the same AuditEntry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditShareViolation { some disj a1, a2: AccessAttempt | a1.aaAudit = a2.aaAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an AuditEntry with aeOp=AppendOp and aeOutcome=Denied to carry a non-null aeNote, or a ReadOp entry to carry a note reference, violating FR-014's structural check. The injection forces a denied-append AuditEntry to carry a note reference.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteIdConstraintViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeOp = AppendOp and ae.aeOutcome = Denied and one ae.aeNote }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an AuditEntry's snapshotted aeRole to differ from the actual caller's role, breaking AttributionCorrectness. The injection forces a mismatch between the caller's role and the audit entry's role field.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.aaAudit.aeRole != a.aaCaller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a PatientRole user to have no assignedRecord (orphan) or a Clinician to carry an assignedRecord, breaking FR-003. The injection forces a PatientRole user with no assignedRecord, which means the ownership-based access predicate cannot resolve correctly.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientPairingViolation { some u: User | u.role = PatientRole and no u.assignedRecord }
